description: Alert, responsive, normal activity, free of disease signs or exhibits only resolved/resolving disease signs
Slightly diminished general activity, subdued but responds normally to external stimuli
Withdrawn, may have head down, fetal posture, hunched, reduced response to external stimuli
Prostrate but able to rise if stimulated, moderate to dramatically reduced response to external stimuli
Persistently prostrate, severely or completely unresponsive, may have signs of respiratory distress
